= BITwiki SMW Property Types - Complete Reference =

== Overview

This document defines the complete property type system for BITwiki's Semantic MediaWiki implementation, ensuring FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) compliance.

== Core Property Types

=== Text Types

{| class="wikitable"
! Property Type !! SMW Declaration !! Use Case !! Example Values
|-
| Text || [[Has type::Text]] || Free-form text, names, descriptions || "BITwiki Charter"
|-
| URL || [[Has type::URL]] || External links, references || https://bitwiki.org/
|-
| Email || [[Has type::Email]] || Contact information || contact@bitwiki.org
|-
| Telephone || [[Has type::Telephone]] || Phone numbers || +1-555-0123
|}

=== Page References

{| class="wikitable"
! Property Type !! SMW Declaration !! Use Case !! Constraints
|-
| Page || [[Has type::Page]] || Internal wiki links || Must exist or be creatable
|-
| Category || [[Has type::Category]] || Category membership || Valid category name
|}

=== Temporal Types

{| class="wikitable"
! Property Type !! SMW Declaration !! Format !! Example
|-
| Date || [[Has type::Date]] || ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) || 2026-02-13
|-
| DateTime || [[Has type::DateTime]] || ISO 8601 with time || 2026-02-13T20:22:00
|}

=== Numeric Types

{| class="wikitable"
! Property Type !! SMW Declaration !! Range !! Example
|-
| Number || [[Has type::Number]] || Any real number || 3.14159
|-
| Integer || [[Has type::Number]] || Whole numbers || 42
|-
| Temperature || [[Has type::Temperature]] || Physical temperature || 298.15 K
|-
| Quantity || [[Has type::Quantity]] || Number with unit || 100 kg
|}

=== Boolean Type

{| class="wikitable"
! Property Type !! SMW Declaration !! Values !! Use Case
|-
| Boolean || [[Has type::Boolean]] || true/false, yes/no, 1/0 || Feature flags, status
|}

=== Complex Types

{| class="wikitable"
! Property Type !! SMW Declaration !! Structure !! Use Case
|-
| Record || [[Has type::Record]] || Multiple sub-properties || Structured data (name, date, value)
|-
| Reference || [[Has type::Reference]] || Citation with metadata || Academic citations
|}

== BITwiki Custom Property Types

=== Epistemic Status

```smw
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Allows value::Axiomatic]]
[[Allows value::Established]]
[[Allows value::Developing]]
[[Allows value::Preliminary]]
[[Allows value::Speculative]]
```

=== Confidence Score

```smw
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has property description::Confidence level from 0.0 to 1.0]]
[[Display precision::2]]
```

=== Agent Attribution

```smw
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has property description::Construct or human responsible for content]]
```

=== Domain Classification

```smw
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Allows value::Systems Science]]
[[Allows value::Philosophy]]
[[Allows value::Technology]]
[[Allows value::Biology]]
[[Allows value::Mathematics]]
[[Allows value::Physics]]
[[Allows value::Chemistry]]
[[Allows value::Social Science]]
```

=== Workflow State

```smw
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Allows value::Draft]]
[[Allows value::Review]]
[[Allows value::Approved]]
[[Allows value::Archived]]
[[Allows value::Deprecated]]
```

== Property Declaration Examples

=== Basic Property

```smw
{{#declare:property
|name=Has author
|type=Page
|description=Entity responsible for creating content
}}
```

=== Constrained Property

```smw
{{#declare:property
|name=Has epistemic status
|type=Text
|allowed values=Axiomatic, Established, Developing, Preliminary, Speculative
|description=Current confidence level in knowledge claim
}}
```

=== Quantified Property

```smw
{{#declare:property
|name=Has confidence
|type=Number
|min=0.0
|max=1.0
|precision=2
|description=Numerical confidence score
}}
```

== Query Patterns

=== Filter by Epistemic Status

```smw
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Established]]
  |format=list
  |limit=50
}}
```

=== Filter by Confidence Range

```smw
{{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.8]]
  [[Category:BITwiki Content]]
  |format=table
  |?Has author
  |?Has epistemic status
}}
```

=== Temporal Queries

```smw
{{#ask: [[Has creation date::>2026-01-01]]
  [[Has creation date::<2026-03-01]]
  |format=timeline
}}
```

== Best Practices

# '''Use verb phrases''': "Has author" not "Author"
# '''Specify types explicitly''': Always declare [[Has type::...]]
# '''Constrain values''': Use [[Allows value::...]] for controlled vocabularies
# '''Document properties''': Include [[Has property description::...]]
# '''Version properties''': Track changes with [[Has version::...]]

== References
* [[SMW Property Definitions]]
* [[BITwiki Ontology Index]]
* [[Template Catalog]]
* Semantic MediaWiki Documentation: https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Properties
